latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — add subtitles to iMovie-exported videos with cloud processing.

- Easily add subtitles to your iMovie video clips by uploading and specifying your requirements in plain language.
- Automatic session and token setup for fast onboarding; 100 free credits per token.
- Handles video upload, editing (including adding captions), and exporting at up to 1080p with no manual timeline editing.
- Supports a variety of common video and audio formats (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, etc.).
- Transparent credit system, error handling, and usage tips included for a smooth experience.
